prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
**BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for a self-employed Kansas City, MO resident. It’s an independent local brokerage that says it compares Marketplace and private plans, checks subsidy eligibility, and serves individuals and small-business owners. Its North Kansas City office is at **1327 Burlington St.**; call **(816) 205-4664**. Its website reports a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews, though ratings and plan availability can change. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/)

Also worth comparing: **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** says it works with self-employed clients and compares carriers in Missouri and Kansas; call **(913) 333-8627**. [AIS](https://aishealthadvisors.com/health-insurance/)

When you speak with either broker, ask them to compare **ACA Marketplace plans and any eligible premium tax credit** using your estimated household income, and confirm your doctors, prescriptions, and preferred hospitals are in-network. For most self-employed people, Marketplace coverage is a useful starting point; an off-Marketplace plan may not qualify for income-based subsidies. A broker can help you compare, but verify the final plan details directly with the insurer before enrolling.
